name: WP Agent
description:
Any WordPress site — self-hosted included — managed entirely from Claude. Connect your site once, then just say what you want: Claude writes, edits, publishes, schedules, and maintains it end to end through 64 purpose-built tools. WP Agent is keyless: no AI API key to bring, nothing to configure.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish posts and pages, update existing content, and manage revisions.

Handle the full media library: upload images, pull free stock photos, set featured images sized for WordPress, and generate an original AI image for a post you're working on.

Run complete SEO workflows — titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and per-post SEO analysis.

Manage categories, tags, menus, comments, authors, site settings, custom CSS, and plugins — all from Claude. Safe by design: destructive actions are confirm-gated, publishing is explicit, and every tool call is audited.

Works with any WordPress site via the WP Agent Connector plugin (one-click pairing from wp-admin) or an application password. Free plan includes 25 posts per month — no credit card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WP Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WP Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getwpagent.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WP Agent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WP Agent lists 64 MCP tools, including activate_plugin, add_media_from_url, add_menu_item, assign_menu_location, buy_extra_site, connect_site, create_category, create_menu, create_post, create_tag, deactivate_plugin, and delete_category.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WP Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to WP Agent in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does WP Agent MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: WP Agent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WP Agent is developed by GetWPAgent. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
